author: daniyalsherafat1
name: waves-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Waves style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#0D1B0F, #3E8E41, #C7F464, #FFFDE1). Features: cursor-reactive (spotlight). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
